title: [NL][Telebank] Payment History export crashes when combining entries
summary: Payment history export in Dutch telebank functionality no longer crashes when combining entries that exceed the 140-character limit for SEPA CT remittance text.
key_points: Adds a string-length cap to prevent overflow when saving combined remittance text to SEPA CT ustrd field
Implements a 140-character limit for the combined text element
Extends test coverage with automated test for the string-length cap functionality
Resolves crash that occurred during payment history export with multiple combined entries
quote: Introducing a standard string-length cap when saving the combined remittance text to the 140-character SEPA CT ustrd text element.
